findings.what: The probe reads /tmp/btz-s5-old/*.olean, which is not durable and not committed; once /tmp is cleared it cannot be rerun, so as a committed file it records a check nobody can repeat. Its result is already recorded in REPORT.json (rename_note) and reproduced in this audit.
findings.fix: Delete it before committing (protocol: probes are deleted afterwards); the REPORT and this AUDIT carry the result. If the loop wants the method kept, move its text into a kb proposal instead (the REPORT already has one on private-name re-pointing).

findings.what: Stale oleans/ileans of the ten moved modules remain (disclosed in REPORT notes (4)). Harmless to the gate now, but a stray 'import GXScaffold.BTZ.<m>' would still resolve against them and hide a missed rename, and their ileans duplicate declaration locations.
findings.fix: Remove them at integration, as in the T-btz-reg-complete-graduate precedent.
